tagline.zh: 神用七天创造了新世界，你呢？
tagline.en: It took God seven days to create a new world. What about you?

menu_note.zh: 七天旅行 · 四项属性 · 十二种结局
menu_note.en: Seven days · Four attributes · Twelve endings

menu_stats.zh: 已完成 {runs} 次旅行  /  已解锁 {count} 个结局

overwrite_text.zh: 新的旅行将覆盖当前进行中的存档。已解锁结局会保留。
overwrite_text.en: Starting again will replace your journey in progress. Unlocked endings will be kept.

talent_note.zh: 出发前总得带上点行李。
talent_note.en: You have to pack something before setting off.

stats_note.zh:
生命归零，旅行立即结束。
其余属性将决定你的七日结局。
stats_note.en:
Zero vitality ends your journey.
Your final attributes decide your ending.

cards_note.zh: 从 {count} 张事件卡中选择一张，再决定如何行动。
cards_note.en: Choose one of {count} encounters, then decide how to respond.

choice_note.zh: 选择一项行动，再点击确认。结果将在确认后揭晓。
choice_note.en: Choose an action and confirm. The outcome is revealed afterwards.

forced_heading.zh: 宇宙没有征求你的意见

forced_note.zh: 强制事件已发生，以下结果已生效。
forced_note.en: This unavoidable event has happened. Its effects have been applied.

result_heading.zh: 这就是宇宙给出的答复

no_events.zh: 今天没有尚未遇见的新奇遇。你平安度过了这一天。
no_events.en: There are no new encounters available today. You make it through the day quietly.

ending_heading.zh: 你的旅行，成为了宇宙传闻。
ending_heading.en: Your journey is now a cosmic story.

death.zh: 旅行于第 {day} 天结束 · 致死事件：{event}
death.en: Journey ended on day {day} · Fatal encounter: {event}

gallery_note.zh: 每一次离谱的旅行，都有值得收藏的终点。
gallery_note.en: Every improbable journey deserves a place in the collection.

save_error_text.zh:
进度仍在当前窗口中。请保留窗口并检查存档目录的写入权限，然后重试。

{error}
save_error_text.en:
Your progress remains in this window. Keep it open, check that the save folder is writable, and retry.

{error}

load_warning.en: A save could not be read

load_warning_text.zh:
原文件已备份，下列无效存档没有载入：
{files}
load_warning_text.en:
The original files have been backed up. These invalid saves were not loaded:
{files}

action_error.zh: 这项操作已结束，请继续当前旅程。
action_error.en: That action is no longer available. Continue your current journey.
